admission_rule: A candidate is admitted iff the native google/gemma-2-2b greedy top-1 next token (fp32 reference forward) equals the first token of its answer string. Candidates failing admission are recorded (with the native top-1 they produced) and dropped; they are never replaced, re-phrased, or supplemented post hoc. The replacement model's clean (no-op) top-1 is used only as a pre-filter to skip attribution on candidates that will not be admitted; the admission of record is the fp32 native top-1.

decision_rule.name: circuit-tracer-native-edge
decision_rule.note: drop = logprob(target|clean) - logprob(target|intervention). native_necessary iff drop>=0.5; native_effect_absent iff drop<=0.1; inconclusive between. These are the existing default_edge_rule thresholds and are NOT tuned after seeing results.

topk_zero_ablate.description: jointly set every top-k feature to 0 (joint zero-ablation)

topk_steer_-2x.description: jointly steer every top-k feature to -2x its natural activation (the attribution-graphs paper's steering)

frozen_attention_iterative.note: circuit-tracer feature_intervention DEFAULT; attention patterns and LayerNorm held fixed, MLP/transcoder effects propagate. The mode circuit-tracer's own intervention demos use.

unconstrained_iterative.note: nothing frozen; attention and LayerNorm recompute in response to the intervention.

direct_effects.note: freeze attention + LayerNorm denominators + all out-of-range MLPs; the fully linearized attribution (the regime the attribution GRAPH edges themselves are computed in).

bootstrap.note: percentile bootstrap over edges (resampling edges) for single-feature agreement rate; over prompts for per-family rates and group rates
